tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm paper, never pure white, in light; near-black blue-slate in dark. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, popovers, the sidebar. One step lighter than `surface` in light, one step lighter in dark; separated by `line`, not by shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, code blocks, wells, the ledger's closed periods. One step darker than `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders between surfaces, table rules, dividers. Decorative only: 1px, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and other controls (3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes). Also the resting outline of the secondary button.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `tile-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, table headers, helper text, timestamps. On `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥6.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text only (≥3:1 on `surface`); never for content a person must read.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The brand's dark: the app-icon tile, the dark slab behind the wordmark, primary buttons' resting fill in light, hero and footer grounds. Dark theme lightens it to a pale blue-slate, so use `on-night` for text on it, never literal white.

tokens.name: night-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed state of `night` fills; the shadow side of a `night` slab.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `night` and `night-deep` (≥11:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: The brand colour, terracotta roof tile: the door mark, primary actions, links, active navigation, selected tabs, the focused side of a toggle. As text only on `surface` and `surface-raised` (4.8:1 light, 7.4:1 dark). Never as a large background behind body text.

tokens.name: tile-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `tile` fills; link hover; the wordmark when it prints in one colour on paper. Dark theme goes lighter, not darker.

tokens.name: tile-tint
tokens.usage: Soft brand ground: selected rows, the active sidebar item, the brand callout. `ink`, `night` and `tile-deep` all read on it.

tokens.name: tile-wash
tokens.usage: A stronger brand ground for illustration blocks and the cover; no text on it below 24px.

tokens.name: on-tile
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `tile` and `tile-deep` fills: paper in light, `night-deep` in dark (≥4.7:1 both themes). Never literal white.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: The dark gap behind the door in the mark; the only shadow the brand draws. Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid, confirmed, matched, quorum reached. Text and icon on `surface`; fill of the success badge with `success-tint`. Always paired with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the success badge and row highlight; `success` reads on it (≥5:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Overdue soon, pending declared payment, needs attention. Text and icon on `surface` (5.2:1 light); on `warning-tint` in badges.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the warning badge and banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, overdue, failed deliveries, validation errors. Text on `surface`; fill of the danger button with `on-tile`. Bluish-red so it sits apart from the terracotta `tile`.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the danger badge, the error banner and invalid fields' helper text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices, announcements, scheduled items. Text and icon on `surface`; on `info-tint` in badges.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the info badge and the announcement banner.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px, offset 2px from the control, on every surface (≥8:1). The one blue in the system besides `info`; never used for anything else.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing hero and the docs landing. Never inside the app.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles on marketing and docs pages; empty-state headlines.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: App page titles (one per screen) and dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and card headings inside the app.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The assembly is on Thursday at 19:30; proxies close the evening before.
styles.usage: Default UI and reading text. 15px, not 14: managers read these screens all day.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names, unit numbers, emphasis inside body copy, table row leads.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, tabs, menu items, badges.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, timestamps, table headers (uppercase is never used), footnotes. Set in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: compact
styles.usage: Table cells in compact density (`--density: 0.75`): bank matching, attendance desk, guard console.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Every money amount, balance and IBAN, so columns align digit for digit. Also hashes, codes and sign-in codes.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: The headline balance on a statement or dashboard tile.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code and configuration in the docs; the CLI's output.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside buttons and inputs (vertical), between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside inputs (horizontal), compact table cells, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, comfortable table cells, form field gap, the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and form sections; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop, between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and marketing rhythm; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section gaps; the minimum clear space around the logo is the mark's own height, which is this at the 64px mark.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, table cell highlights, code spans.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, popovers, banners.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The app-icon tile only (22% of its side: 112px on a 512px icon). The mark itself has no rounded corners — doors are square.

shadow.note: Surfaces are separated by `line` and a lightness step, not by shadows. The two below are the only ones.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the command palette, toasts: floating things only.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Every border: `line` or `line-strong` at this width. No 2px borders except the focus ring.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The `focus` ring, drawn with a 2px offset.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Lucide icons at 20px (16px inside badges and inputs).
